requestedText: Add module-local regression tests for the provider-agnostic Telegram renderer boundary.

evidence: The module-local test source executes deterministic in-memory cases and has no runtime loading or dynamic reference mechanism.
The test source has no production or external consumer; it verifies only the local renderer boundary.
The test source adds no telemetry, monitoring, delivery, HTTP, or provider integration.
The Contract requires module-local renderer tests and excludes provider integration, architecture-test, and global-policy changes.
